title: Using complex prompts to identify fine-grained biases in image generation through ChatGPT-4o

bias_targets.methodology: Generating complex, multi-sentence text vignettes for specific occupations (e.g., poet, judge) with varying emotional sentiments using ChatGPT-4o, using those vignettes as prompts for DALL-E 3, and manually coding the resulting generated subjects and background figures as Male or Female.
